parent.execution_guard: C070-D must not be scored unless the corrected-parent C070-C workflow completes successfully and reproduces the preregistered structural direction: 3/3 fold transition-LogLoss wins, pooled semimarkov-minus-markov LogLoss < 0, and match-bootstrap 90% upper bound < 0.

estimand.target: conditional Draw versus one-goal win at 90 minutes
estimand.matching: exact competition maximum-cardinality matched pairs without replacement

information_boundary.new_signal: only the C070-C Semi-Markov minus Markov duration-dependent probability correction
information_boundary.reason: C070-C indicates that score-state duration improves the structural next-minute transition likelihood while the absolute generator remains worse calibrated than the incumbent Draw baseline. C070-D therefore transports only the duration correction into the incumbent probability system instead of replacing the incumbent with the raw generator.

integration_rule.incumbent_probability: the frozen C069-R3 baseline prediction for each outer-fold matched test row
integration_rule.markov_probability: the frozen C070-C Markov-generator conditional Draw probability P(diff=0)/P(abs(diff)<=1)
integration_rule.semimarkov_probability: the frozen C070-C Semi-Markov-generator conditional Draw probability P(diff=0)/P(abs(diff)<=1)

evaluation.primary: candidate minus incumbent matched-test Log Loss

stop_rules.after_pass: Do not tune alpha or fit a calibrator on the already-consumed outer-test rows. Freeze a separate confirmation/calibration contract before opening any new A package or protected sample.
